In this masterclass you interpret sculptural placement, not just identify deities.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Iconographic method
  • Architectural placement
  • Interpretive humility

How the time is spent

  1. Iconographic method 30 min

    Attributes, posture, context and textual cross-check.

    You: identification grid

  2. Architectural placement 60 min

    Niches, lintels and programme.

    You: map examples

  3. Interpretive humility 30 min

    Multiple readings and uncertainty.

    You: annotated visual

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify deities using attributes, posture and context, cross-checked against texts.
  • Explain how sculptures placed in niches and on lintels form part of a larger programme.
  • Recognise that a sculpture may support several readings and describe the uncertainty involved.
